steps.en: Supply account assets, prompts and keys; restore missing job routes, then start
steps.zh: 备齐账号素材、提示词与密钥，补齐接口再启动
提交文章，要求生成口播稿

steps.en: Generate a draft and retain source text for review
steps.zh: 生成稿件并保存原文供审核

steps.en: Correct and approve the draft, then select a voice
steps.zh: 修正并确认稿件，选择音色

steps.en: Synthesize speech and collect word timing
steps.zh: 合成语音并取得词级时间

steps.en: Review audio, prepare pictures and approve the visual plan
steps.zh: 试听，准备画面并确认视觉规划

steps.en: Render and check the MP4 before marking it completed
steps.zh: 渲染并检查 MP4，再标记完成

value.en: After integration repair, review each stage without assembling speech, captions and video by hand
value.zh: 补齐接口后逐步审核，不必手工拼装配音、字幕和成片
